original.text: A fresh start can make all the difference. If your A-Level results weren’t what you hoped for, our retake programmes are designed to get you back on track. We provide a supportive environment and personalised tuition focused on rebuilding confidence and securing the grades you need to progress – 78% of grades received by Greene’s students are A*-B. It’s your opportunity to move forward, better equipped for the future.

label: While studying A level Further Mathematics, students will explore advanced mathematical concepts, techniques, and proble

original.text: While studying A level Further Mathematics, students will explore advanced mathematical concepts, techniques, and problem-solving strategies, building a deeper understanding of pure and applied mathematics. With personalised guidance from experienced tutors, they develop analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and a strong foundation for future STEM and finance-related studies.

label: Greene’s College Oxford invites students to enrol at any time throughout the year, liberating students from a one-size-f

original.text: Greene’s College Oxford invites students to enrol at any time throughout the year, liberating students from a one-size-fits-all curriculum, as well as the fixed academic calendar. Our students are encouraged to identify clearly their academic goals and take strategic steps to achieve them. This means enrolling in the courses that support their objectives, and none of the classes that do not.

original.text: Learning can take place in our campus in Oxford, UK, or online from anywhere in the world. You can also make use of our campuses in Estoril and Lisbon, Portugal as online study spaces.

label: We teach through the tutorial method to encourage analytical and creative thinking. This approach to learning is defined

original.text: We teach through the tutorial method to encourage analytical and creative thinking. This approach to learning is defined by small group tuition, taught in the Socratic style, with an emphasis on independent study. Our students find they can retain more information when guided by their own curiosity – and it provides a more seamless transition from A levels to university life.

label: We work with only the very best academic tutors. Each one has achieved academic excellence in their field and every tuto

original.text: We work with only the very best academic tutors. Each one has achieved academic excellence in their field and every tutorial radiates this enthusiasm. Our tutors are selected for their ability to convey the required information in a meaningful manner and, with the help of our Personal Tutors, they inspire students to seek answers for themselves. With almost 55 years’ experience, Greene’s has the tools to empower students to succeed.

original.text: Amy has extensive experience in giving Mathematics tuition across all age groups as well as ten years of experience in the classroom. Julian has also coached and participated in rowing and real tennis at an international level having considerable with his rowing teams.
